patch.summary:
Choose Bitbucket Cloud only if your buying job matches “Atlassian git hosting — Free ≤5 users; Standard $3.65/user/mo (min 5-user equivalent); Pre” rather than Fly.io's shape. Choose Fly.io only if your buying job matches “Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regio” rather than Bitbucket Cloud's shape. Workflow advantage: Bitbucket Cloud leans source-control-devops; Fly.io leans cloud-paas. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Bitbucket Cloud is Atlassian git hosting — Free ≤5 users; Standard $3.65/user/mo (min 5-user equivalent); Premium $7.25/user/mo.; Fly.io is Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regions. Support Standard $29/mo is support, not hostin.
- Workflow coverage skew: Bitbucket Cloud-leaning source-control-devops vs Fly.io-leaning cloud-paas.
- Researched limits: Bitbucket Cloud — Paid plans bill a 5-user floor even for 2-person teams; Fly.io — Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award.

Limitations — Bitbucket Cloud: Paid plans bill a 5-user floor even for 2-person teams; Ecosystem and Actions marketplace trail GitHub; Fly.io: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award; Support Standard $29/mo is support — not the hosting floor.
